messages.subject: Bioc-training call May 11, 3-4pm CEST
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

a quick reminder of the bioconductor-training call on Monday, May 11, 3-4pm CEST.
Carlo Pecoraro from Physalia will join and give an overview of the platform and discuss the collaboration with the Bioconductor training committee.

Jitsi link: https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching
Agenda document: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1s2QMk5XA-uhBVprAO3ZDk1Yfv1cnUWLp9zdvYq9Feu4/edit

Hope to see you there!
Charlotte & Jenny
